svg.text: 412 x 312; left and right 312 deep x 300 tall; back 400 x 300.

svg.text: Cut every hole with the panels (wall holes picture): right

svg.text: wall Peltier opening 90 x 100, three 12 mm ports, 6 mm drain,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four 4 mm clamp holes; back wall two 12 mm HEPA holes, two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 mm gland holes; left wall a 16 mm aerosol hole.

svg.text: Solvent weld: sides and back stand between top and bottom;

svg.text: the front stays open. Clamp square; leave 24 h.
